name: Sour plum drink
description: Smoked plums, hawthorn and liquorice boiled and chilled — the summer heat drink.

tcm.note: Sour, cooling and thirst-generating; drunk in high summer.

histamine.note: Smoked dried plums, which is both a dried fruit and a smoked one.

guna.note: Aged, cured or fermented — the condition the texts call tamasic, whatever the ingredient started as.
